decisions.evidence: Proof 5.1 incorrectly equated full-data treatment-stratum probabilities from equal observed laws. With constant L and independent fair A, independent fair potential outcomes versus identical fair potential outcomes give identical observed (A,L,Y) laws but P_a(Y^0=Y^1)=1/2 versus 1. Repaired the inference using the common observed Q_a=(L,Y)|A=a law, CE event-integral uniqueness under its covariate marginal, and positivity to transfer the mean class to P_L. Clarified P_a acts on F; formulas and hypotheses are unchanged. All 21 direct suppliers and five direct consumers were independently checked; no consumer correction is needed.
